story.storyBefore:
We built this because we were lost too —
watching AI do what we spent years learning,
wondering if we’d still matter.
story.storyHighlight: Then we realized: the answer was never out there. It was always in here.
story.storyAfter: This tool is a gift we made for ourselves, and now for you.

items.d: 38 career interest and values questions, about 5 minutes. Map your RIASEC profile, discover your value orientation, and see which directions energize you most.
86 scenario-based questions across personality, values, and cognitive style. Not checkboxes — real dilemmas that reveal what your résumé never shows.
Your psychological profile — revealed instantly. Career archetype, personality dimensions, cognitive style, shadow side. A mirror for how you tend to show up, beyond what your résumé says.
AI-generated career report: career anchors, top matches, growth paths, and blind spots. Not generic advice — a map drawn from your unique pattern.
Not a chatbot. A coach that reads your assessment context — your values, tensions, and career directions. Plus a personalized action plan that turns reflection into concrete next steps.

archetypes.label: 12 CAREER ARCHETYPES
archetypes.heading: Not labels.
archetypes.description: Each archetype maps two interest dimensions to a career identity — with its own strengths, growth edges, and career directions. You’ll see which roles naturally fit, which ones drain you, and why your past choices make more sense than you thought.

items.d: Building a career across countries and cultures without a home-court advantage. Deep Dive maps how your cross-cultural identity shapes your career strengths — so you stop seeing it as a gap and start using it as an edge.

items.t: People Finding Themselves in the AI Wave
items.d: When AI can write, design, translate, and code — what’s left that’s yours? That question isn’t weakness. It’s the beginning of something important. Deep Dive helps you notice what is harder to replace simply — what you truly care about.
Feeling the pull toward something new but unsure which direction fits the real you. Deep Dive identifies the thread connecting your past roles — and points to where it leads next.
Infinite options, zero clarity. Deep Dive cuts through the noise with a profile built on how you actually think and decide — not what the market says you should want.
